svg.title: Scrutate in a terminal
svg.desc: A terminal running scrutate 0.1.0 in a copy of this repository's crates/scrutate/src, indexed with scrutate index, one command at a time: scrutate grep --index max_filesize; scrutate search "parse a size like 10M"; scrutate callers text_within; scrutate refs index_dir. Each command is typed, its output (the binary's own, captured by tools/gen_assets.py capture) arrives, the matches of each grep are marked with a highlighter, and the screen clears for the next; a line '...' marks output left out.
svg.text: // ENGINE B IN A TERMINAL // REAL OUTPUT, SCRUTATE 0.1.0
